TASK2.label: Compulsory community service in schools
TASK2.text: Some people believe that unpaid community service should be a compulsory part of high school programmes. Others believe students should spend this time on their academic studies instead. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Working from home: pros & cons
TASK2.text: Working from home has become increasingly common in recent years. Some argue this is beneficial for both employers and employees, while others believe it has significant drawbacks. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Social media & young people
TASK2.text: Social media platforms have a largely negative effect on young people today. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

TASK2.label: Government funding for the arts
TASK2.text: Some people think that governments should fund the arts, while others believe public money should be spent on other priorities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Free university education
TASK2.text: In some countries, university tuition is free for all students. Others argue that students should contribute to the cost of their education. Do the advantages of free university education outweigh the disadvantages?

TASK2.label: Rise of fast food worldwide
TASK2.text: Fast food is becoming increasingly popular around the world. Why is this the case? Is this a positive or negative development?

TASK2.label: Caring for the elderly: family vs facilities
TASK2.text: In some cultures, elderly people are looked after by their families at home. In others, they are cared for in specialist facilities. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each approach?

TASK2.label: Spending on space exploration
TASK2.text: Some people believe that the money spent on space exploration would be better used addressing problems on Earth. Others argue that space research benefits humanity in the long term. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Growth in private car ownership
TASK2.text: Private car ownership is increasing in many countries. This is causing serious problems for both individuals and society as a whole. What are the causes of this trend and what measures could be taken to address it?

TASK2.label: Globalisation & cultural identity
TASK2.text: Globalisation is causing many local cultures and traditions to disappear. Some see this as a positive development, while others see it as a loss. To what extent do you agree that globalisation is a threat to cultural identity?

TASK2.label: Online vs on-campus university study
TASK2.text: Many universities now offer online courses as an alternative to classes delivered on campus. Do you think this is a positive or negative development for students and universities?

TASK2.label: Taking a gap year before university
TASK2.text: Some people argue that school leavers should take a year off before starting university to travel or gain work experience. Others believe they should go straight to university. What are the advantages and disadvantages of taking a gap year?

TASK2.label: Should everyone adopt a vegetarian diet?
TASK2.text: Some people argue that everyone should adopt a vegetarian diet because of the environmental impact of meat production. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

TASK2.label: Advertising aimed at children
TASK2.text: Advertising aimed at children has a negative impact on both children and society. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

TASK2.label: Nuclear energy expansion
TASK2.text: Nuclear energy is a clean and safe source of power. Some believe it should be expanded to meet growing global energy demands, while others argue the risks are too great. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Elite athlete funding vs mass participation
TASK2.text: Some countries invest heavily in training elite athletes to compete in international competitions. Others believe this money should be used to encourage all citizens to take part in sport. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Urban traffic congestion
TASK2.text: Traffic congestion in cities is a growing problem around the world. What are the main causes of this problem and what solutions would you recommend?

TASK2.label: The global plastic waste problem
TASK2.text: The amount of plastic waste produced globally is a serious environmental problem. Why has this problem arisen and what can governments and individuals do to address it?

TASK2.label: Foreign languages at primary school
TASK2.text: Some people believe that children should learn a foreign language from the very first year of school. Others argue that this is too young. What are the advantages and disadvantages of introducing foreign languages at primary school?

TASK2.label: Should zoos be closed?
TASK2.text: Some people believe that zoos are cruel and that all zoos should be closed. Others argue that zoos play an important role in conservation. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Capital punishment as a deterrent
TASK2.text: Capital punishment is still used in some countries as a deterrent for serious crimes. Some argue it is justified, while others believe it is never acceptable. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Volunteering in developing countries
TASK2.text: Voluntary work in developing countries is becoming increasingly popular. Some argue it benefits both the volunteers and local communities, while others believe it causes more harm than good. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

TASK2.label: Using IQ tests in recruitment
TASK2.text: Some companies use intelligence tests when recruiting staff. Do the advantages of using such tests outweigh the disadvantages?

TASK2.label: Rising mental health problems in youth
TASK2.text: Mental health problems among young people are on the rise. Why is this happening and what steps can schools and governments take to address the problem?

TASK2.label: International migration: benefits & problems
TASK2.text: International migration has increased significantly in recent decades. Some see this as beneficial, while others believe it creates serious problems. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

TASK2.label: Robots & AI replacing human workers
TASK2.text: Robots and artificial intelligence are increasingly replacing human workers in many industries. What are the effects of this trend and do the benefits outweigh the drawbacks?

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a friend: visiting your home
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
A friend from another country is coming to stay with you for a holiday. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:
• tell your friend how to get to your home from the airport
• describe what the weather will be like
• suggest some activities you could do together.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a library: joining as a member
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You want to join a library in a town you have recently moved to. Write a letter to the head librarian. In your letter:
• explain why you want to join the library
• ask what is required to become a member
• ask about any special services the library offers.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter of application for a part-time job
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You have seen an advertisement for a part-time job at a local company. Write a letter of application to the company. In your letter:
• explain why you are interested in the job
• describe your relevant experience and skills
• say when you are available for an interview.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a neighbour about noise
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are experiencing problems with noise from a neighbouring property. Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter:
• describe the problem
• explain how it is affecting you
• suggest what your neighbour could do to resolve the situation.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to rent a holiday apartment
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You and a group of friends are planning a holiday and wish to rent an apartment. Write a letter to the apartment owner. In your letter:
• describe your group and the dates you wish to visit
• ask about facilities available in the apartment
• ask about the local area and transport links.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to an airline about damaged luggage
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You recently travelled by plane and discovered that your bag had been damaged. Write a letter to the airline. In your letter:
• describe what happened
• explain what was damaged and how
• say what you would like the airline to do.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a departing colleague
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
A colleague at work is leaving the company. Write a letter to your colleague. In your letter:
• say what you will miss most about working with them
• describe your best memory of working together
• wish them well for the future and suggest staying in touch.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to the council about a local park
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are concerned about the condition of a local park. Write a letter to the local council. In your letter:
• describe the current condition of the park
• explain why this is a problem for the local community
• suggest what improvements you would like to see made.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a college about a language course
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You want to attend an English language course at a college in an English-speaking country. Write a letter to the college. In your letter:
• explain your reasons for wanting to study there
• ask for information about course options and costs
• ask about accommodation for students.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter advising a friend about moving cities
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
A friend has written to you asking for your advice about whether to move to the city where you live to look for work. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:
• describe what kinds of jobs are available in your city
• explain what the advantages and disadvantages of living there are
• give your personal recommendation.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to cancel a gym membership
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You have been a member of a gym for two years but want to cancel your membership. Write a letter to the gym manager. In your letter:
• explain why you want to cancel your membership
• ask about the cancellation process and any fees
• ask whether the membership could be transferred to a friend.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to volunteer at a local festival
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You would like to volunteer at a local cultural festival. Write a letter to the festival organiser. In your letter:
• explain why you are interested in volunteering
• describe any relevant experience or skills you have
• ask what the volunteer role would involve.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Complaint letter to a hotel manager
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You stayed at a hotel recently and were unhappy with several aspects of your stay. Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter:
• describe the problems you experienced
• explain how these problems affected your stay
• say what you expect the hotel to do in response.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to borrow an item from a friend
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You need to borrow an item from a friend while you are visiting their area. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:
• explain why you need the item
• say when you will need it and for how long
• offer to do something in return.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter about a school reunion
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are organising a reunion for former classmates. Write a letter to one of your old friends from school. In your letter:
• remind your friend who you are and how you knew each other
• give details of the planned reunion event
• ask your friend to spread the word to others.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to start a community sports club
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You want to start a new sports club in your local community. Write a letter to the local recreation centre. In your letter:
• describe the sport and explain why you want to start the club
• ask whether the centre has facilities you could use
• ask about any costs or requirements involved.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter requesting a work reference
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are applying for a new job and need a reference from a former employer. Write a letter to your former manager. In your letter:
• remind your manager of the work you did together
• explain the new job you are applying for
• ask if they would be willing to provide a reference.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a councillor about local traffic
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
There is a serious traffic problem near your home that is causing problems for local residents. Write a letter to your local government representative. In your letter:
• describe the traffic problem and where it occurs
• explain how it is affecting people in the area
• suggest what action should be taken to resolve the problem.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to an airline about a flight delay
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You recently missed an important event because your flight was significantly delayed. Write a letter to the airline. In your letter:
• describe what happened and how long the delay was
• explain what event you missed as a result
• say what compensation you believe you are entitled to.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Thank-you letter to a former mentor
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
Someone helped you significantly when you first started a new job. Write a letter to this person. In your letter:
• explain why you are writing now
• describe the specific ways in which they helped you
• say how their help has benefited you in the long term.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter enquiring about childcare
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are looking for childcare for your young child while you return to work. Write a letter to a local childcare centre. In your letter:
• describe your child and their needs
• ask about the hours, cost, and facilities available
• ask how you can arrange a visit to the centre.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a newspaper editor
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You have read an article in your local newspaper that you strongly disagree with. Write a letter to the editor of the newspaper. In your letter:
• explain which article you are writing about
• say what you disagree with and why
• suggest what you think the newspaper should do differently.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter enquiring about cooking classes
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You want to learn how to cook a particular type of cuisine and have heard that a local restaurant offers cooking classes. Write a letter to the restaurant. In your letter:
• explain your interest in learning to cook this cuisine
• ask for details about the classes, including schedule and cost
• ask whether the classes are suitable for beginners.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a letting agency about renting
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are looking for a flat to rent in a new city where you are starting a job. Write a letter to a letting agency. In your letter:
• describe the type of property you are looking for
• explain your budget and when you need to move in
• ask about the services the agency provides to tenants.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Complaint letter about an internet outage
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You have been without internet service at home for two weeks despite several complaints to your provider. Write a letter to the internet service provider. In your letter:
• describe the problem and how long it has lasted
• explain how the lack of service has affected you
• state clearly what you want the company to do.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a conference organiser
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
Your manager has asked you to attend an international conference on behalf of your company. Write a letter to the conference organiser. In your letter:
• confirm your attendance and the name of your company
• ask for details about the programme and speakers
• ask about accommodation options near the venue.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter to a lost property office
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You have lost an important item on public transport. Write a letter to the lost property office. In your letter:
• describe the item in detail
• explain when and where you think you lost it
• ask what the process is for claiming lost property.

TASK1_GENERAL.label: Letter asking a friend to help plan a surprise
TASK1_GENERAL.text:
You are planning a surprise birthday party for a mutual friend and need help from another friend. Write a letter to this friend. In your letter:
• explain what you are planning and why you need their help
• describe what you would like them to do
• ask them to keep the party a secret from the person being celebrated.
